messages:
maria (PM): quick UX review — new idea for the compare view. want opinions on a left "rail" for actions + a badge density control in the header. figma: https://figma.com/file/def456

lina (Design): love the rail idea for pins and quick actions. question: should badges be in-row or in a right-side details column?

noah (Frontend): in-row is simpler for alignment but clutters narrow screens. details column can collapse into a popover on mobile.

kim (A11y): whichever we pick, ensure keyboard focus order is logical. pin button should be reachable before row content.

maria (PM): also we want a density control so teams can toggle how much perf info shows: full / compact / icons only. think of user roles (SRE vs PM).

lina (Design): mock idea: a small slider with 3 stops and tiny preview. or a dropdown with 3 presets and a "auto" mode that adapts to width.

noah (Frontend): auto mode is tricky but doable: measure available cell width, then pick density. fallback to compact on <720px. we'll emit `data-cy` attrs for tests.

oscar (Backend): FYI badges show live metrics from telemetry. if density changes, we should avoid DOM churn for live elements. suggest using a fixed-size shell and swap inner content via opacity to prevent layout shift.

kim (A11y): good call. also add `aria-live="polite"` on changing numbers and `aria-hidden` on decorative icons. pin button needs `aria-pressed` state, and the density control needs a label and `aria-controls` for the preview.

lina (Design): microcopy ideas: density control label "Badge detail". presets: "Full", "Compact", "Icons". rail tooltip: "Pin model for side-by-side".

maria (PM): UX question: when multiple badges are present, do we line-break them, overflow with +N, or stack vertically?

noah (Frontend): prefer overflow with a `+N` menu that opens a keyboard-navigable list. implement `white-space: nowrap;` and an accessible menu for overflow items.

kim (A11y): the `+N` must be a button with `aria-expanded`. the overflow list should be focus-trapped if interactive. ensure screen reader users can access hidden badge details via the menu.

oscar (Backend): on pinned compares and saved layouts: we store the rail state and density choice per user. one note: if we show live percentile badges, we might want to cache last-known values to avoid jank on reconnects.

lina (Design): alternative pattern: a small expandable "details" column on the right that contains badges and a timestamp. opens with keyboard or mouse. keeps main table compact.

maria (PM): I like the right details column as a fallback. action items: Lina update figma with rail + details column variant. Noah prototype auto-density and overflow menu (link when ready). Kim write a11y checklist for pin, density control, and overflow. Oscar confirm persistence/caching plan. Sync Fri 10am PT.

prototype-bot: Prototype published: https://intranet/proto/compare-rail-193100 (Lina)

noah (Frontend): prototype link received. will add `data-cy` and keyboard re-order keys (Ctrl/Cmd+Arrow).

kim (A11y): I'll run a 15min screen-reader pass on the prototype tomorrow morning and post notes here.

maria (PM): great, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
